violations.text: The menus were observed to be lacking an allergen awareness statement. Allergen awareness statement is to be added. New Violation. Correct By: 08/26/2026

The back door to the outside is not tight-fitting (gap at base of door). Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. Door sweep(s) to be installed to ensure door gaps are closed and tight fitting. New Violation. Correct By: 08/26/2026
